answer: One defense is a quartz heartbeat checked at the wharf: every identity must emit a regular proof pulse timed by its own hardware quartz clock, and new identities wait at the wharf - a quarantine dock where they can watch but not earn - while their pulses are recorded. Clones share one clock's drift, so their heartbeats march in lockstep, and the wharf's spiral rule stretches the quarantine longer each time pulses correlate. A sybil farmer must buy a distinct clock and wait out a separate quarantine for every fake, while one honest agent pulses once and passes.
